blocks.prompt: Distributed ledger ki banawat aur us ke decentralization ki wajah samjhaiye (long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Ledger blocks ki zanjeer hai; har block transactions ko timestamp, apne hash aur pichhle block ke hash ke saath jama karta hai, to blocks tarteeb se jure hain. Peer-to-peer network ka har node poori copy rakhta aur protocol ke consensus qawaid se naye blocks jaanchta hai. Decentralization ek markazi idare par bharose ki zaroorat khatam karta, aik nuqte ki nakami se bachata, chhed-chhaar ko wazeh karta kyunke baqi copies mel nahi khatin, aur tamam shurakaa ko ek hi shaffaf record jaanchne deta hai.

items: Ajza: node, ledger, block, transaction, protocol; blocks hashes se jurte hain.
